enriched.summary: A aula aborda tópicos como gramática no uso de tempos verbais (passado, presente e futuro), vocabulário relacionado a situações do cotidiano e exemplos de expressões comuns. Também inclui frases práticas com tradução e estrutura gramatical para reforçar o aprendizado.

vocabulary.definition: A person who makes people laugh through jokes and humor.
examples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer to participate in a festival in the Middle East.

vocabulary.definition: An expression of readiness to do something for someone else in exchange for something.
examples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer to participate in a festival in the Middle East.

vocabulary.definition: To move forward or improve in development.
examples: Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer.

vocabulary.definition: The process of creating a plan to spend money.
examples: Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company?

vocabulary.definition: Medical care given to a patient for an illness or injury.
examples: Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer.

grammar.explanation: The past continuous tense is used to indicate an action that was ongoing in the past when another action occurred.
rules: It is often used with time clauses like 'when' or 'while'.
examples: While I was doing shopping for Christmas, I also bought some things for me.
Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company?
commonMistakes: Using simple past instead of past continuous for ongoing actions.
Forgetting to add '-ing' to the verb.

grammar.explanation: 'Will' is used for decisions made at the moment of speaking or for predictions, while 'going to' is used for plans or intentions.
rules: Use 'will' + base verb for spontaneous decisions.
Use 'am/is/are going to' + base verb for planned actions.
examples: What are you going to do when you retire?
commonMistakes: Confusing 'will' and 'going to' in contexts where one is more appropriate.

expressions.usage: Often used to talk about resolving conflicts or stopping negative situations.
examples: Trump promised he will put an end to the war in Ukraine.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: While I _____ (shop) for Christmas, I also bought some things for me.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The action was ongoing in the past, so the past continuous tense is used.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: 'O que você vai fazer quando aposentar-se?'
practiceQuestions.answer: What are you going to do when you retire?
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence asks about a future plan, so 'going to' is used.

culturalNotes: Stand-up comedy is a popular form of entertainment in many Western countries, often involving comedians performing live in front of an audience.
AI is revolutionizing industries like medicine, especially in countries investing heavily in technology.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences with 'was/were + verb-ing' to get comfortable with the past continuous tense.
Use flashcards to memorize vocabulary with definitions and examples.
originalExamples: The stand-up comedian refused the one-million-dollar offer to participate in a festival in the Middle East. (O comediante de stand-up recusou a oferta de um milhão de dólares para participar de um festival no Oriente Médio.)
Trump promised he will put an end to the war in Ukraine. (Trump prometeu que ele acabará com a guerra na Ucrânia.)
Medicine will progress much faster with the help of AI especially in the treatment of cancer. (A medicina progredirá mais rapidamente com a ajuda da IA, especialmente no tratamento do câncer.)
While I was doing shopping for Christmas, I also bought some things for me. (Enquanto eu estava fazendo compras para o Natal, eu também comprei algumas coisas para mim.)
Was your department doing the budgeting for next year when the Director left the company? (Seu departamento estava fazendo o orçamento do próximo ano quando o Diretor deixou a empresa?)
He met his wife when he was working in Japan. (Ele conheceu sua esposa quando ele estava trabalhando no Japão.)
Did you have fun / have a good time in Vancouver? (Vocês se divertiram em Vancouver?)
Was she wearing a coat when she left? (Ela estava usando um casaco quando ela saiu?)
When will we colonize Mars? (Quando colonizaremos Marte?)
What are you going to do when you retire? (O que você vai fazer quando aposentar-se?)
Were you driving at high speed when the police stopped you? (Você estava dirigindo a alta velocidade quando a polícia o parou?)
I met Tom and Jane at the airport some weeks ago. (Encontrei Tom e Jane no aeroporto algumas semanas atrás.)
They were going to Paris. (Eles estavam indo para Paris.)
We talked while we were waiting for our flights. (Nós conversamos enquanto esperávamos por nossos vôos.)
Tom is going to be late for work because he left home late. (Tom vai se atrasar para chegar no trabalho porque ele saiu de casa atrasado.)
